summary: StudentEmergencyContacts is a user control in a web application for managing emergency contact information for students. It comprises UI controls, validation mechanisms, business logic for creating and updating records, and handles session-based permissions. Emergency contact details are entered, validated, and maintained using a modal popup/dialog, FormView controls, and data sources, with special handling for phone fields and edit permissions.
purpose: To allow users (likely school staff or administrators) to view, add, and update emergency contact details for students in a structured and validated way, ensuring that only authorized users can make changes.
